title: Shadow AI List
description: Risk-ranked registry of AI tools: look up an AI tool's risk or check if a domain is shadow AI.
summary: Risk-ranked registry of AI tools: look up an AI tool's risk or check if a domain is shadow AI.
offersHint: Risk-ranked registry of AI tools: look up an AI tool's risk or check if a domain is shadow AI. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://ailist.airiskmanagement.ca/mcp

toolsPreview.name: lookup_ai_tool_risk
toolsPreview.description: Look up an AI tool by name, vendor, or domain and return its AI Exposure Index risk score, risk band, category, and whether it trains on user data. Covers the free top 100.

toolsPreview.name: check_domain_against_registry
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a domain or subdomain belongs to a known AI tool - i.e. whether traffic to it is shadow AI. Returns the tool and its risk if matched. Covers the free top 100.

toolsPreview.name: list_shadow_ai
toolsPreview.description: List AI tools from the registry, optionally filtered by category. Returns name, domain, category, and risk band. Covers the free top 100.

toolsPreview.name: get_top_risky_ai
toolsPreview.description: Get the highest-risk AI tools by AI Exposure Index risk score. Returns name, domain, category, and risk score + band. Covers the free top 100.
